title: Anthropic’s money in three numbers: what it is raising, what it has promised to spend, and what it brings in
intro: Slide through the three sides of Anthropic’s compute bet as its IPO approaches. Each step shows only figures reported by Reuters, Bloomberg and The Decoder.
note: IPO figures are from Anthropic’s filing as reported by Reuters and can change before pricing. The oversubscription, the private placement and the commitments are Bloomberg’s reporting. The revenue run rate is Anthropic’s figure from its filings, as reported by The Decoder. These numbers cover different time spans, so they should not be subtracted from one another.
